title: Cantina Brawl
caption: Cantina Brawl (V)
game_text: If a battle was just initiated at an interior site where both players have a participating character armed with a weapon, your weapon destiny draws there are +1 (+3 if at Cantina) for remainder of turn.
lore: “...watch your step. This place can be a little rough.” The Mos Eisley Cantina harbors smugglers, thieves, cutthroats, criminals, mercenaries and bounty hunters!
